## Name & positioning
- Product name: OnboardPlan
- One-line value: OnboardPlan builds a 30/60/90 day onboarding plan by role — what the new hire should learn, do, and own, with check-ins and a first-week checklist.

## FAQ
Q1. What is OnboardPlan?
A1. OnboardPlan builds a 30/60/90 day onboarding plan by role with check-ins and a first-week checklist.
Q2. What inputs does it need?
A2. The role and a little context about the team or product.
Q3. Does it include owners?
A3. Yes. Check-ins list suggested owners so accountability is clear.
Q4. Who should use it?
A4. Managers and People Ops who need a structured ramp without a full L&D team.
Q5. Can I edit the plan?
A5. Yes. Treat it as a draft you tailor to your company.
Q6. Does it replace HR policy?
A6. No. It is decision-support for onboarding plans, not legal or HR policy.
